We provide the perfect mix of seriously good outsourcing, business process augmentation, and industry expertise to deliver a trendsetting customer experience. Let's come together and augment your customer experience. Together we’ll change the world!

Solbeg is a world-class partner in consulting, business process automation, technology, and software engineering services. Since 2018, Solbeg is a part of Helmes corporate group, a respected European organization with over 30-year history, headquartered in the Estonian capital Tallinn. The Group is a reliable and diverse organization of over 1500 team members in 7 countries, with industry leaders and reputable institutions among its partners like KuhneNagel, OECD, Solera, Telia, ServiceChannel, LumaTouch.
Whether it’s peer-to-peer, internal-to-external, or tool-to-tool, Zendesk makes all types of collaboration easy.
Zendesk makes running your online business easy with pre-built integrations that provide a smooth customer journey.
This guide will help you choose the right apps for your business from the more than 1,200 available on the Marketplace.

Using our API and apps framework you can build pretty much anything. And once you do, you can place it in The Zendesk Marketplace for all Zendesk customers to find. Or just keep it for yourself–whatever feels right.
